description: Presidential Secretariat - Construction of Medical Faculty of University of Moratuwa
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for a specific purpose (construction of a Medical Faculty and related urban development activities). It declares that a particular parcel of land is urgently required, provides a detailed legal description of the land (including its extent, name, survey plan number, and boundaries), and identifies the surrounding landowners. The content is focused on the land itself and its acquisition under the Urban Development Projects (Special Provisions) Act, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4). While it mentions the President and a Minister, this is in the context of the legal authority for the land declaration, not the primary focus of the notice.
